commands.output_summary: Generated exact frozen 50-case coverage, 11 digital contract rows, 33 supplemental lighting rows, 121 confusion cells, six CVD rows, and five tracked artifact manifests.

failure_cases.observed_behavior: All 33 frozen physical color-lighting cases remain NOT_RUN.
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Measure the 11 physical color families under three declared lights.
failure_cases.user_impact: No camera color-name accuracy, lighting stability, or population performance claim can be made.
failure_cases.mitigation: Acquire licensed or consented physical captures and rerun while retaining this supplemental synthetic evidence separately.

failure_cases.observed_behavior: Supplemental synthetic lighting name stability was 0.545, below the 0.80 diagnostic target.
failure_cases.expected_behavior: At least 0.80 stability on the declared diagnostic.
failure_cases.user_impact: Lighting changes can alter the displayed basic color family.
failure_cases.mitigation: Keep lighting quality visible; collect physical evidence before tuning.

limitations: Synthetic RGB gains do not model physical illuminants, exposure, camera ISP, glare, or display behavior.
The 33 frozen physical cases remain NOT_RUN and are not replaced by supplemental data.
Color-name scores and margins are heuristics rather than calibrated probabilities.
CVD risk values are configured relational heuristics, not medical probabilities.
No demographic, clinical, usability, or population-level claim is supported.

responsible_ai.privacy_summary: This evaluator uses tracked digital patches and inline synthetic data only.
responsible_ai.bias_coverage_summary: Skin tone, body presentation, material, camera, display, and physical lighting coverage remain unvalidated.
responsible_ai.environmental_summary: No training or model download; deterministic CPU color science reuses the locked environment.
responsible_ai.license_summary: Generated evidence is Apache-2.0; existing repository attribution documents OpenCV, DaltonLens/Machado, and color anchors.
